description: Complete Street Rule is David Wasserman's procedural design tool for multimodal streets in ArcGIS CityEngine. Parameterised CGA rules create road lanes, bicycle facilities, sidewalks, parking, vegetation and street furniture, with reports that respond to design changes. Inputs are street geometry and design attributes; outputs are three-dimensional scenes and indicators such as modal space allocation, parking counts and bicycle stress. Spatial detail is selectable through levels of detail, while the tool compares design scenarios, not producing a measured time series. Source is free under Apache-2.0, but CityEngine requires separate access. A limitation is that the reports and rendered layouts do not replace dynamic traffic or engineering-compliance analysis. The rules can prepare infrastructure digital-twin scenes and compare street designs. OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap) supplies related spatial context. The current README documents per-lane integration with CityEngine 2025. No scene assets or commercial software were downloaded.
